{{Orphan|date=December 2020}}

'''Michael Meyer-Hermann''' (born 1967 in [[Reinbek]]<ref name="annewill">[https://daserste.ndr.de/annewill/archiv/Unsere-Gaeste,gaesteliste1208.html ''Unsere Gäste''], Webseite of [[Norddeutscher Rundfunk|NDR]] for the talk show [[Anne Will (talk show)|Anne Will]] on April 19th, 2020.</ref>) is a professor at the [[Technical University of Braunschweig]] and head of the department of Systems Immunology at the [[Helmholtz Centre for Infection Research]].

== Career ==
Meyer-Hermann studied [[Physics]], [[Mathematics]] and [[Philosophy]] in [[Frankfurt]] and [[Paris]]. His diploma thesis titled "QCD-Summenregeln mit Massen" about [[Quantum chromodynamics]] was published in 1993.<ref>Michael Meyer-Hermann: [http://publikationen.ub.uni-frankfurt.de/files/4622/meyer-hermann_diplom.pdf ''QCD-Summenregeln mit Massen''], Diploma thesis, [[Goethe University Frankfurt]], 1993.</ref> In 1997, he finished his doctorate in [[Theoretical Physics|theoretical]] [[Particle Physics]] at the [[Goethe University Frankfurt]].<ref>Michael Meyer-Hermann: [http://d-nb.info/953844684 ''Die innere Struktur des Nukleons: Vielteilchenkorrelatoren und Störungskorrekturen im Limes großer Nf'']. Dissertation, [[Goethe University Frankfurt]], 1997.</ref> He founded the research group "Theoretical Biophysics" at the [[Technical University Dresden]] in 1998 which he headed until 2003. He worked at the [[University of Oxford]] during 2004. From 2005 to 2010, he had the role of a [[Fellow]] at the [[Frankfurt Institute for Advanced Studies]] (FIAS).<ref name="annewill"/><ref name="hzi"/> Since 2010, he is a professor at the [[Technical University of Braunschweig]] and head of the department of Systems Immunology at the Helmholtz Centre for Infection Research.<ref>[https://magazin.tu-braunschweig.de/pi-post/antrittsvorlesung-von-prof-dr-michael-meyer-hermann-moderne-lebenswissenschaften-sind-ohne-physik-und-mathematik-nicht-denkbar/ ''Antrittsvorlesung von Prof. Dr. Michael Meyer-Hermann''], press release of the [[Technical University of Braunschweig]], May 18, 2011.</ref>

In his group, he develops methods for theoretical [[cell biology]] for an improved understanding of functionality in the [[adaptive immune system]] and the interplay between the [[Nervous system|nervous]], [[Endocrine system|endocrine]], and [[Immune system]]. This includes research about [[T cell]]s and [[B cell]]s, viral and bacterial diseases, metabolic disorders, diabetes, and cancer. He employs mathematical methods for modeling medical and biological systems. The methods range from ordinary as well as partial differential equations and [[agent-based model]]s to algorithms from [[adaptive control]] and [[artificial intelligence]].<ref name="hzi">[https://www.helmholtz-hzi.de/de/forschung/forschungsschwerpunkte/immunantwort-und-interventionen/system-immunologie/m-meyer-hermann/ ''Prof. Dr. Michael Meyer-Hermann''], [[Helmholtz-Zentrum für Infektionsforschung]], accessed August 31, 2020.</ref><ref>[https://loop.frontiersin.org/people/52175/bio ''Michael Meyer-Hermann''], Website of [[Frontiers Journal Series]], accessed August 31, 2020.</ref>

In the context of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Germany]], a model based on an extended  [[Compartmental models in epidemiology|SEIR model]] was developed in his group<ref>Arnab Bandyopadhyay et&nbsp;al.: [https://www.helmholtz.de/fileadmin/user_upload/01_forschung/Helmholtz-COVID-19-Papier_02.pdf ''Stellungnahme der Helmholtz-Initiative  "Systemische Epidemiologische Analyse der COVID-19-Epidemie"''], 13 April 2020.</ref><ref>Sahamoddin Khailaie, Tanmay Mitra, Arnab Bandyopadhyay, Marta Schips, Pietro Mascheroni, Patrizio Vanella, Berit Lange, Sebastian Binder, Michael Meyer-Hermann: [https://gitlab.com/simm/covid19/secir/raw/master/paper.pdf ''Estimate of the development of the epidemic reproduction number R<sub>t</sub> from Coronavirus SARS-CoV-2 case data and implications for political measures based on prognostics''], 7 April 2020, [[doi:10.1101/2020.04.04.20053637]].</ref> that received broad public attention. In the following weeks, regularly updated estimates of the reproductive number in the different German federal states were published.<ref>[https://gitlab.com/simm/covid19/secir/-/wikis/Report Report] with updated numbers for the article by Khailaie et al.</ref> In April 2020, Meyer-Hermann argued from an epidemiological point of view against loosening of restrictions concerning [[social distancing]], [[curfew]]s and other measures in interviews and ''[[Anne Will (talk show)]]'' to keep the reproduction number substantially below 1 and contain the pandemic.<ref>Florian Schumann: [https://www.zeit.de/wissen/gesundheit/2020-04/corona-krise-schulen-kitas-michael-meyer-hermann-lockerungen-leopoldina ''"Jetzt wäre jede Form von Lockerung gefährlich"'']. In: ''[[Zeit Online]]'', April 15, 2020.</ref><ref>[https://www.tagesspiegel.de/wissen/herdenimmunitaet-waere-erst-in-25-jahren-erreicht-helmholtz-forscher-erklaert-an-einer-zahl-warum-strenge-corona-regeln-bleiben-muessen/25742256.html ''Helmholtz-Forscher erklärt an einer Zahl, warum strenge Corona-Regeln bleiben müssen'']. In: ''[[Der Tagesspiegel]]'', April 15, 2020.</ref><ref>Cornelia Karin Hendrich: [https://www.welt.de/vermischtes/article207369943/Epidemiologe-bei-Anne-Will-Die-Reproduktionszahl-von-0-7-ist-ein-kuenstlicher-Effekt.html ''"Die Reproduktionszahl von 0,7 ist ein künstlicher Effekt"'']. In: ''[[Welt Online]]'', accessed April 20, 2020.</ref> In an interdisciplinary study together with [[Clemens Fuest]] ([[ifo Institute for Economic Research]]) ge postulated that a reproduction number around 0.75 would be optimal from an economic point of view without compromising public health goals, stating that there was no conflict between economic and public health interests regarding substantial loosening of restrictions.<ref>[[Florian Dorn]], Sahamoddin Khailaie, Marc Stöckli, Sebastian Binder, Berit Lange, Andreas Peichl, Patrizio Vanella, Timo Wollmershäuser, [[Clemens Fuest]], Michael Meyer-Hermann: [https://www.ifo.de/DocDL/sd-2020-digital-06-ifo-helmholtz-wirtschaft-gesundheit-corona_1.pdf ''Das gemeinsame Interesse von Gesundheit und Wirtschaft: Eine Szenarienrechnung zur Eindämmung der Corona-Pandemie'']. In: ''[[ifo Schnelldienst]] Digital''. Nr. 6, 2020. [[ifo Institut für Wirtschaftsforschung|ifo Institut]], [[Helmholtz-Zentrum für Infektionsforschung]] (Hrsg.), May 12, 2020.</ref><ref>[https://www.zeit.de/wissen/2020-05/corona-krise-wirtschaft-folgen-lockerungen-massnahmen-oeffnungen ''Schnelle Lockerungen bringen der Wirtschaft Verluste'']. In: ''[[Zeit Online]]'', May 13, 2020.</ref><ref>[https://www.welt.de/regionales/bayern/article207953987/Wirtschafts-und-Infektionsforscher-Vorsichtige-Lockerung.html ''Wirtschafts- und Infektionsforscher: Vorsichtige Lockerung'']. In: ''[[Welt Online]]'', May 13, 2020.</ref>
